messages:
mike_ryan: Heads-up — planning to enable the new capacity_playbook_v2 toggles (burst + queueing adjustments) as a canary in prod tomorrow 09:00 PDT. Want a quick sync: who can ack guardrails and be on-call for the 09:00–10:00 window?

jess-prod: I can be there for the window. Can you list the exact flags and the canary audience size?

mike_ryan: Thanks. Flags: `capacity_playbook_v2.burst_enabled`, `capacity_playbook_v2.queueing_enabled`, and `max_concurrency.soft_cap` tweak. Canary audience: 2% of traffic, exclude our top-5 customers (skiplist). Guardrails: 95th p50 latency increase <= 20%, queue depth < 800, error rate <= 0.5% absolute change. Rollback immediately if any hard-slo breach or queue depth > 1200. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/capacity-playbook-v2

rupert: Quick Q — are we changing soft_cap from 1k -> 800 tokens-per-request or is that per-worker concurrency? Need exact metric so we can model SLO risk.

mike_ryan: It's per-worker max_concurrency.soft_cap = 800. We keep hard_cap at 1200. This will reduce per-instance tail latency under high burst but may increase queueing; that's why queueing toggle is paired.

sarah-sre: I'll be on pager rotation for that hour. Suggest pre-checks: 15m before toggle confirm baseline metrics, and a post-toggle smoke at +5m, +15m. I'll add a dashboard panel for quick pass/fail.

oncall-bot: @sarah-sre scheduled on-call coverage for 2024-06-04 08:50 PDT - 10:10 PDT. Response SLA: 15m. :bell:

devops-bot: Flip command we use from LaunchDarkly (example):
```
ld toggle capacity_playbook_v2.burst_enabled --env prod --on --target 2%
ld toggle capacity_playbook_v2.queueing_enabled --env prod --on --target 2%
ld set max_concurrency.soft_cap --env prod --value 800 --target 2%
```
Please run these in order and wait for metrics stabilization between each.

jess-prod: Confirming skiplist: do not include accounts A12345, B67890, C23456, D78901, E34567. I'll add them to the LD target rule.

mike_ryan: I'll open INF-2345 and attach the checklists. Also will post the canary metrics baseline 30m before. Who is OK to hit the flip button when green? @devops-bot or @rupert?

rupert: I can do the flips. I'll watch the queues and latency. If queue depth query `sum(rate(queue_enqueue_count[1m]))` spikes >5x baseline or `max(queue_depth)` > 1000 we rollback. Suggest we document that rollback command too.

sarah-sre: Add these automated smoke checks to the runbook before flipping: 1) 95th latency vs baseline, 2) error-rate delta, 3) queue depth and backpressure. If any fails -> rollback. I can validate the smoke results.

mike_ryan: Sounds good. Plan: 08:30 PDT baseline screenshots, 08:50 pre-check, 09:00 toggle burst, wait 5m, toggle queueing, wait 10m, set soft_cap if stable. Rollback criteria as above. I'll tag infra on the ticket.

jess-prod: ack from my side. I'll monitor app-level errors and customer-facing 500s.

oncall-bot: Deploy window: 09:00 PDT — 09:15 PDT. Please mark status in INF-2345.

rupert: One last ask — please ensure the canary traffic is evenly spread across regions (us-west/us-east/eu) and not concentrated. Otherwise results will be noisy.

mike_ryan: Good point, will set region-distribution rule in LD. Thanks everyone — will post updates in the thread and in INF-2345 during the rollout. :thumbsup:
